newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN CREDIT AGRICOLE 1996 PROFIT UP 8.2 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN CREDIT AGRICOLE 1996 PROFIT UP 8.2 PCT.

text.p: Full-year 1996
(millions Belgian francs unless stated)
Net profit 776 vs 717
Interest rate profit 3,916 vs 3,592
Charges 1,793 vs 1,719
Provisions, write downs, depreciation 745 vs 527
Exceptional gains 118 vs 32
Total assets 160,900 up 8.7 pct
NOTE - Credit Agricole/Landbouwkrediet, a small, non-listed
agricultural bank, said in a statement on Thursday that its
earnings were infludenced by two key elements: a 228 million
franc capital gain, realised by cooperative funds following the
sale of shares of Credit Agricole to Bacob, and the constitution
of reserve funds and provisions worth more than 500 million
francs within the framework of prudent bank management.
Following the October 1996 privatisation of the bank, three
parties each hold 33 percent of its capital: Belgian Bacob Bank,
Swiss insurer Swiss Life and an association of
cooperative funds.
